## The xkcd comics used in this handbook

Every embedded xkcd comic is by Randall Munroe and is reused from [xkcd](https://xkcd.com/) under the [Creative Commons Attribution–NonCommercial 2.5 licence](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/2.5/). The comics are excluded from the handbook's CC BY 4.0 content licence. Each appearance links to the original comic and transcript.

| Comic | Used on |
|---|---|
| [xkcd #552: Correlation](https://xkcd.com/552/) | Matching the design to the claim |
| [xkcd #1205: Is It Worth the Time?](https://xkcd.com/1205/) | Milestones, dependencies and weekly progress |
| [xkcd #1425: Tasks](https://xkcd.com/1425/) | Your first 90 days |
| [xkcd #1597: Git](https://xkcd.com/1597/) | Git, GitHub and AI-assisted workflows |
| [xkcd #1782: Team Chat](https://xkcd.com/1782/) | Collaboration, handoffs and scope |
| [xkcd #2304: Preprint](https://xkcd.com/2304/) | Publishing and peer review |
| [xkcd #2582: Data Trap](https://xkcd.com/2582/) | Data states, codebooks and provenance |

The machine-readable page-by-page placement and asset path are recorded in the [`page-visuals register`](https://github.com/hareshsuppiah/handbook-for-the-recently-enrolled/blob/main/research/page-visuals.csv).
